note: Typed orphan exemptions. Every row names its reachability class and a concrete reason. The gate REFUSES: a fresh orphan not listed here, a listed file that became reachable or was deleted (cured => RED until pruned via --regen), and a row with an invalid class or a thin reason. --regen PRUNES cured rows only — adding a row is a deliberate hand edit with a class and a reason, never a mechanical relock.
